common_overrides: pretrained actor and frozen normalization; restored shared exploration std
new critic and optimizer; existing critic readiness500..1000
six identical critic phase features in both conditions
limitations: Actual contact-point slip penalty applies to all achieved floor contacts, including UNKNOWN and SWING reference labels.
Phase penalties have public-reference swing coverage of10.33%, but Quest only0.424% in four sampled one-second windows per clip.
Quest signal includes four original clips and their mirrors, not eight independent demonstrations.
This tests the combined contact reward revision and potential transfer from public references, not a well-covered direct Quest swing curriculum.
Conservative phase thresholds were not relaxed to manufacture coverage.
The critic receives the same phase features in both conditions; actor contract is unchanged.
Desired phase never uses achieved force/contact; falling foot cannot relabel itself STANCE.
Single robot + flat floor enforced; net body force gated by sole floor proximity is a floor-contact proxy, not exact pair-resolved force.
Material sphere-centre velocity is a finite difference at50Hz plus angular bottom-radius velocity, not an exact1000Hz contact solver velocity.
Matched experiment combines actual contact-point slip and phase penalties; it cannot separately attribute a benefit to either term.
Repeatedly inspected12-clip Quest holdout is validation, not an independent test.
This source package is research code. It does not change, install or promote a Quest policy.
Low label coverage is a property of this conservative classifier and sampled windows. It is not a count of visible Meta steps or proof that Generative Legs do not alternate stepping.
